in_sanskrit.name: अमाय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Amay is derived from the Sanskrit word अमार (Amara), meaning immortal. It is a name that evokes a sense of eternal life, strength, and resilience.

in_hindi.name: अमाय
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Amay in Hindi is also derived from the Sanskrit word अमार (Amara), which means immortal. This name is popular in both Hindu and Jain communities and is given to boys as a symbol of strength, longevity, and spiritual growth.

in_tamil.name: அமய
